correctness.rationale: Primary Smadyarov 2026 full proof §2 explicitly obtains 3[φ(ab,c,d)−aφ(b,c,d)]=0 and 2φ(a,b,φ(c,d,e))=0. Defect alternation from prior identity theorem holds char≠2, so only factors 2,3 require inversion. Lemma2.2 word spanning uses only sums and signs and preserves degrees of normal factors 1 or3; Sections3–4 maximal-annihilator, solvability, minimal-ideal arguments require no additional zero-characteristic steps and import char-free ordinary Zinbiel nilpotency. Every minimal ideal M is annihilating and 1D. Inducting on dimension A/M gives A^n⊆M so A^{n+1}=0. For original degree d≥3n+1, normal word has ≥ceil(d/3)≥n+1 left factors and vanishes; no sharpness asserted. Examined source line-by-line in load-bearing proof sections; symbolic verifier alone not used as proof.
